title: The War in Kryta

{{otheruses|the quest|an overview of the War content|War in Kryta}} {{ Quest infobox | id = 1176 | name = The War in Kryta | campaign = War in Kryta | region = Kryta | type = Primary | given by = [[Murro]] | given at = [[Lion's Arch]] | preceded by = [[Hell's Precipice]] ''or''
[[Against the Destroyers]] }} [[The War in Kryta]] is an ''overarching'' quest that guides characters through the [[War in Kryta]]. When this quest is in your log, foes in [[Kryta]] will be different and you will have access to additional optional quests. It officially begins when eligible characters speak with [[Murro]] in [[Lion's Arch]]. However, you can also be drawn into it by speaking with [[Keiran Thackeray|Lieutenant Thackeray]] in [[Ice Cliff Chasms]] and taking [[A Good Deed]] or by witnessing [[War in Kryta dialogues#Dialogue 2 - Search for Allies|Search for Allies]] in [[Talmark Wilderness]]. ==Requirements== * Completing either ''[[Guild Wars Prophecies|Prophecies]]'' or ''[[Guild Wars Eye of the North|Eye of the North]]'' ''(primary)'' * Completing either [[Zinn's Task]] or [[The Knowledgeable Asura]] ''(secondary)'' * Not having completed [[The Battle for Lion's Arch]] ==Objectives== * Find the [[Shining Blade camp|Shining Blade Camp]] in [[Talmark Wilderness]]. * Enlist the aid of the Asura. ([[Asuran Allies]]) * Enlist the aid of the Ebon Vanguard. ([[Ebon Vanguard Allies]]) * Defeat the Inquisitors of the [[White Mantle]]: [[Wanted: Inquisitor Lashona|Lashona]], [[Wanted: Inquisitor Bauer|Bauer]], and [[Wanted: Inquisitor Lovisa|Lovisa]]. * Defeat the three [[Mursaat]] to give hope to the people: [[Willem the Demeaning]], [[Aily the Innocent]], and [[Koril the Malignant]]. * [[Mustering a Response|Locate the Shining Blade's allies]], and gather them at Lion's Arch. * Defend Lion's Arch. * Return to [[Salma]] for your congratulatory message. ==Walkthrough== # Take the “War in Kryta” quest from [[Murro]] in Lions Arch # Locate the [[Shining Blade camp]], which you will find in the southwest corner of Talmark Wilderness (just south of the westernmost bridge across the river). # Complete [[Asuran Allies]] and [[Ebon Vanguard Allies]]. # Revisit the [[Shining Blade camp]]. # Take (and complete) the 3 inquisitor [[Wanted by the Shining Blade|Wanted]] quests ([[Inquisitor Lashona]], [[Inquisitor Bauer|Bauer]], and [[Inquisitor Lovisa|Lovisa]]) from the signpost in [[Lion's Arch Keep]]. # Follow and complete the storyline by going to Lion's Arch Keep and taking the quests offered by [[Princess Salma]]: #* [[Riverside Assassination]], [[A Little Help From Above]], [[Temple of the Intolerable]], [[Mustering a Response]], and [[The Battle for Lion's Arch]]. #* Sometimes, after accepting a quest reward, you will have to exit Lion's Arch Keep and return to progress the storyline. # See Queen Salma for your final reward and congratulatory message. ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Murro :''"The conflict in Kryta is escalating into civil war. If you are a true ally of Kryta you will rally to her cause."'' {{offer dialogue |accept = I'll take care of it. |decline = I'm sorry. I have other things I must do. |ask = I am [[Murro]], a humble historian and scribe. Dark days are coming, and the fate of Kryta is uncertain. Let me be your guide though{{sic}} this impending war in Kryta.}} ===Intermediate dialogue=== {{section-stub}} *[[War in Kryta dialogues#Dialogue 2 - Search for Allies|Search for Allies]] *[[Ebon Vanguard Allies#Dialogue|Ebon Vanguard Allies dialogue]] *[[Asuran Allies#Dialogue|Asuran Allies dialogue]] *[[War in Kryta dialogues#Dialogue 7 - Mantle on the Move|Mantle on the Move]] ===Reward dialogue=== ;Queen Salma :''"The War in Kryta is finally over. Thank you for your help, brave adventurer. We will now turn our efforts to maintaining the peace we have won."'' == Notes == * It is possible to acquire this quest and witness Dialog 2 - Search for Allies without owning ''Guild Wars Eye of the North'', however you cannot complete Asuran Allies or Ebon Vanguard Allies since travel to the [[Far Shiverpeaks]] and [[Tarnished Coast]] is impossible. ** Even though these quests cannot be completed, there will still be a change in spawns in the areas of [[Kryta]]. ** Sometimes Dialog 2 will play out without first talking to Murro to acquire this quest. If the dialogue completes, then the change in spawns will occur even without having the quest in your quest log. * As alternative to following this quest, the War in Kryta content can be completed by following the [[War in Kryta/Walkthrough|self-guided walkthrough]]; however, this quest reduces the amount of dialogue and rezoning required to complete the War in Kryta. * During the War (including bounties and missions), [[henchmen]] can be as low as level 10 while [[Peacekeeper]] and White Mantle foes are level 20 and above. ** If you have fewer than seven [[hero]]es unlocked, consider playing in [[hard mode]], which raises the henchmen to level 20. ** For other suggestions, see the individual walkthroughs. * If you begin the War in Kryta right after completion of Eye of the North storyline and with lack of progression in Prophecies, note that you will meet foes with [[Spectral Agony]]. It's highly advised to get the character's armor [[infusion|infused]] before exploring the War in Kryta areas and doing the storyline quests. {{anomaly|Players have reported irregular spawns when the party is composed of 2 or more players at different points in the War in Kryta storyline, notably in [[Talmark Wilderness (War in Kryta)|Talmark Wilderness]].}} {{anomaly|The dialogue when asking about the quest is the same as Murro's default dialogue before completing the quest.}} == Trivia == * This quest was added on [[Feedback:Game updates/20101118|November 18, 2010]].
